paraphrase_notes: Package 16 supports hazard/risk context while explicitly warning against presenting Crew Blueprint's teaching taxonomy as a codified OSHA taxonomy.
applicability_notes: Internal teaching model; underlying OSHA concepts are narrower and source-specific.
required_qualifier: NCCE/behavior framing is Crew Blueprint instructional architecture.

paraphrase_notes: Package 20 supports reporting and escalation concepts; the NCCE name/order remains internal framing.
applicability_notes: Do not label NCCE an OSHA or national stagehand standard.
required_qualifier: Framework name and sequence are Crew Blueprint-created.

paraphrase_notes: Supports fatigue/work demand as a risk-management concern but not the course's exact communication or break sequence.
applicability_notes: Exact work/rest and break rules remain employer/CBA/jurisdiction specific.
required_qualifier: Use only for the human-factors premise; Crew Blueprint supplies the communication/escalation framing.

paraphrase_notes: Supports simultaneous equipment traffic, walking-surface, overhead/suspended-load and controlled-system hazards plus recognition/report/escalation boundaries.
applicability_notes: Actual risk priority is context-dependent and cannot be universalized from the example alone.
required_qualifier: Do not create a universal hazard ranking from the scenario.

paraphrase_notes: Supports context-dependent PPE and separation between production attire and hazard-selected PPE.
applicability_notes: Exact PPE depends on task/site/employer requirements.
required_qualifier: Examples are conditional, not a universal kit.

paraphrase_notes: Supports show blacks as production/performance clothing distinct from work PPE and varying by call.
applicability_notes: Local/institution examples only.
required_qualifier: Production-specific clothing expectations control.

paraphrase_notes: Supports employer hazard assessment, PPE selection/communication and training where applicable.
applicability_notes: General-industry Subpart I context where applicable; individual PPE categories have additional standards.
required_qualifier: Actual workplace hazard assessment/site requirements control.

paraphrase_notes: Supports hazard-based PPE selection but does not support the claim that a production clothing direction necessarily proves the hazard assessment changed.
applicability_notes: Appearance direction and PPE/hazard assessment can be separate requirements.
required_qualifier: Do not infer hazard-assessment change merely from a dress-direction change.
authority_owner: employer/site safety process and production separately

paraphrase_notes: Supports truck/dock work, controlled loading/unloading and loader-directed workflow, but not a universal rear-to-front physics rule.
applicability_notes: Actual trailer loading pattern, restraints and cargo-control process vary.
required_qualifier: Follow the assigned loader/cargo process; do not teach one universal sequence.

paraphrase_notes: Supports controlling wheeled-load movement around blind routes by changing route, adding help or following the assigned method.
applicability_notes: No universal crew-size or spotter formula follows from the packet.
required_qualifier: Actual load/route/equipment and workplace process determine method and crew size.

paraphrase_notes: Supports deliberate team coordination and stop/escalate behavior while rejecting universal weight, crew-size or movement-method rules.
applicability_notes: Exact body positioning and technique vary by load/route/task.
required_qualifier: Do not treat current detailed ramp/body-position instructions as universally safe.

paraphrase_notes: Supports unloading, movement, distribution and department support as recurring load-in work.
applicability_notes: Exact sequence and assignments vary by call.
required_qualifier: Treat as recurring workflow principles rather than one universal route sequence.

paraphrase_notes: Supports destination, staging and organization as part of controlled material flow.
applicability_notes: Final placement/location remains department/venue controlled.
required_qualifier: Assigned destination and site process control.

paraphrase_notes: Supports ordinary tool readiness without implying technical, powered, electrical, rigging or system-modification authority.
applicability_notes: Tool/task authority is assignment and system specific.
required_qualifier: Recognition/possession does not establish authorization.

paraphrase_notes: Supports employer responsibility for safe condition of covered tools/equipment; does not supply universal learner inspection or function-test procedures.
applicability_notes: Specific inspection criteria depend on equipment, manufacturer and employer process.
required_qualifier: Report obvious defects; do not invent generic functional testing for unfamiliar equipment.

paraphrase_notes: Supports recognition, handoff and storage only; explicitly excludes powered/cutting/testing/rigging-tool procedure.
applicability_notes: Ordinary non-powered hand-tool scope only.
required_qualifier: Model/task procedure remains external.

paraphrase_notes: Supports deliberate coordination and one clearly understood work-control method, while exact commands remain non-universal.
applicability_notes: Crew language and method vary by task/site.
required_qualifier: Do not universalize exact words, caller location or count-down sequence.

paraphrase_notes: Supports recognition/avoid/report/escalate around controlled systems and equipment-specific authorization limits.
applicability_notes: Different departments and systems use different authority mechanisms.
required_qualifier: Actual assignment, employer and system rules control permitted support.

paraphrase_notes: Supports multiple entry routes and honest representation of skills/training as part of professional employment navigation.
applicability_notes: Employer/local hiring standards vary.
required_qualifier: Do not imply one national hiring script or credential requirement.

paraphrase_notes: Supports recurring expectations around reliability, punctuality, safety, teamwork and learning while explicitly rejecting one national callback scoring system.
applicability_notes: No fixed number of calls guarantees specialization or better assignments.
required_qualifier: Present callback factors as recurring patterns, not guarantees.

paraphrase_notes: Supports multiple development pathways and role-specific progression rather than self-declared specialist competence.
applicability_notes: Invitation is one possible pathway, not a universal prerequisite.
required_qualifier: Training/hiring/referral/assignment pathways vary by employer/local/sector.

paraphrase_notes: Shows that real onboarding/development periods exist but are not standardized to one Crew Blueprint schedule.
applicability_notes: Local/institution/employer examples only.
required_qualifier: Early-call sequence remains Crew Blueprint instructional framing.
authority_owner: Crew Blueprint for sequence; employer/local for actual development process
